votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 20 of 2025, to approve the Ballpark NEXT Community Design Plan.
votes.description: Adopts the Ballpark NEXT Community Design Plan for the City-owned Smith's Ballpark and parking lot, focusing on adaptive reuse and redevelopment to promote connectivity, green space, community-centered space, wellness, neighborhood safety, and history.

votes.motion: Approve the CRA Fiscal Year 2024-2025 Final Audit.
votes.description: Approves the CRA's annual audit for fiscal year 2024-25, reflecting the Agency's financial condition as of June 30, 2025, which received a clean audit opinion with no findings of concern.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property.
votes.description: Authorizes the CRA Board to convene a closed session to discuss real property purchase, exchange, or lease strategy pursuant to Utah Code Section 52-4-205.

votes.motion: Exit Closed Session and return as the City Council.
votes.description: Formally closes the closed session and reconvenes the Board in open session.
